pla-01.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: AAC vocabulary image. Style: flat 2D educational illustration, simple solid colors, dark clear outlines, no 3D or photographic textures. A complete blue twin-bell alarm clock on white, representing SECOND as a unit of time. Plain white dial with sixty small black ticks, NO numerals or lettering. Exactly THREE hands from one central pivot: short thick dark gray hour hand pointing left, longer broad gray minute hand pointing straight up, and an extremely THIN bright RED SECOND HAND extending nearly to the ticks diagonally down-right at 5 o'clock. The red second hand is distinctly thinner than both gray hands. A separate small red arrow outside the clock at lower right points precisely to the red second hand tip. All clock, bells, feet, and arrow fully visible, with generous white margin. No extra arrows or hands. Pure white background. One clear central concept, minimal necessary context, generous white margins on ALL sides. All people full body and all objects fully inside image, natural anatomy/hands. Anatomical detail may use natural body-part crop. Absolutely NO text, letters, numbers, punctuation, lettering, labels, branding, watermarks or pseudowriting anywhere, including tiny hardware and clothing. No border. Image square. Vocabulary word is displayed outside image by the app, never inside.
